title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy misjudge each other badly before slowly learning who the other really is, in a sharp comedy about manners, money and marriage.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A young scientist brings a creature to life and then abandons it, setting off a tragedy about ambition, loneliness and responsibility.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: Nick Carraway watches his mysterious neighbour Jay Gatsby chase a lost love through the parties and excess of 1920s Long Island.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: A readable tour of the universe, from the Big Bang to black holes, written for people with no background in physics.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: Explains evolution from the point of view of genes, and how that view accounts for cooperation and altruism in living things.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A sweeping journey through space and the history of science, told with curiosity and wonder.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: How a fairly ordinary species of ape came to dominate the planet, told through the cognitive, agricultural and scientific revolutions.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: Asks why some societies conquered others, and answers with geography, crops, animals and disease rather than people.

title: The Silk Roads
author: Peter Frankopan
description: World history retold from the trade routes linking East and West, putting Central Asia and the Middle East at the centre.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: Practical habits for writing code that is easy to read, test and change, with many before-and-after examples.

title: The Pragmatic Programmer
author: Andrew Hunt & David Thomas
description: Short, practical lessons on becoming a better developer, from managing tools to thinking about design and teamwork.

title: Eloquent JavaScript
author: Marijn Haverbeke
description: A friendly introduction to programming and to JavaScript, with exercises that build real projects in the browser.
